title: isometric system map spec
description: Input to render.mjs. Everything here must be derived from files that exist in the repository being mapped. render.mjs re-checks every citation against disk and refuses to render if one is wrong.

repo.description: Shown first in the header strip. Repo name, optionally · branch or variant.

title.description: What this map is of — a system, not a repo. 'The Ingest Pipeline', not 'meridian'.

subtitle.description: One line, lowercase, describing the journey the map traces.

stats.description: Domain-specific counters a maintainer would want on the wall. Never generic node/edge counts.

intro.description: 2-4 paragraphs shown when nothing is selected. Wrap a phrase in [[double brackets]] to highlight it.

readIt.description: How to read the map. Supports [[highlight]] and inline HTML.

groups.description: Palisades. One per runtime boundary — process, deployment unit, trust zone, network edge. Not source-tree folders.

state.description: planned draws the wall dashed — built but not switched on

sections.description: Legend headings, in the order they should appear. Nodes reference these by id.

nodes.description: Buildings. Hard cap 40, legible cap ~28 per level — past that, merge into district nodes and push detail into children.

edges.description: Real dependencies only. Every edge must name the call site or config line that creates it.

kind.description: control = a synchronous call, A makes B do something and waits. data = a payload moves. async = queue, event, cron, poll — decoupled in time.

label.description: Short phrase naming what actually crosses.

flows.description: Named journeys through the graph, animated by Run the flow / Trace one step.

name.description: Told as an event, e.g. 'An event arrives'.

caption.description: One sentence for this hop. Supports [[highlight]].

cites.description: Verified evidence. Paths are relative to --root. Cite only files you have actually read.

path.description: Repo-relative path. Must exist on disk.

lines.description: "42" or "42-88". Must be inside the file.

note.description: What is at those lines, in the reader's terms.

code.description: 1-2 char mnemonic worn on the roof and shown in the legend. Pick something memorable (P for the archive it Persists), never sequential letters. Children take the parent's letter plus a digit.

name.description: What a maintainer calls it out loud.

shape.description: block = service/process. slab = shared library everyone stands on. stack = store/archive/versioned data. fins = replicated workers, one fin per replica. plate = thin adapter/config/binding. tower = measurement, observability, or a gate everything passes through.

group.description: palisade id — only if it genuinely sits inside that boundary

metrics.description: Drives the massing. Nothing here is decorative.

cell.description: Escape hatch. Pins the building to explicit grid coordinates and overrides auto-layout. Use only to fix a composition that reads wrong.

does.description: Plain language, no jargon, no framework names. What would be lost if you deleted it. Supports [[highlight]].

built.description: The implementation: shape of the code, the mechanism, the thing that surprised you.

condition.description: What is currently wrong: known bugs, TODOs, dead code, missing tests, perf cliffs, unfinished migrations. Omit only when genuinely clean — never invent a fault, never hide one.

children.description: Interior of this building, reachable with ↵. One level only — children may not have children.
